question:
Calculate the GDP at factor cost given in the following data.

GDP at market price = 600 crores

Consumption of fixed capital = 100 crores

Indirect taxes = 200 crores

Subsidies = 50 crores
solution:
The correct answer is **450 Crores**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **GDP at factor cost **is calculated by **adjusting the GDP at market price for indirect taxes and subsidies.**
 
• According to these questions,​
 
 
• **GDP at Market Price** = ₹600 crores
 
• **Consumption of Fixed Capital** (Depreciation) = ₹100 crores
 
• **Indirect Taxes** = ₹200 crores
 
• **Subsidies** = ₹50 crores
 
• The** formula is GDP at factor cost = GDP at market price - Indirect taxes + Subsidies.**
 
• 
 
Using the given values, we get:

 
⇒ 600 crores - 200 crores + 50 crores = 450 crores.

 
 
• 
 
Therefore,** the ****GDP at factor cost is ₹450 crores.**
